OBJECT_AT_EXACT_POSITION.rule: One specified object occupies one stated position.

OBJECT_AT_EITHER_END.rule: One specified object occupies either the first or last position.

SPECIFIED_OBJECTS_AT_BOTH_ENDS.rule: Two specified objects occupy the two end positions in either order.

OBJECT_EXCLUDED_FROM_ENDS.rule: One specified object occupies any position except the two ends.

PRESCRIBED_RELATIVE_ORDER.rule: A specified chain keeps one prescribed relative order without requiring consecutive positions.

INDEPENDENT_RELATIVE_ORDER_CHAINS.rule: Two disjoint specified chains each retain their own prescribed relative order.

STRICT_ALTERNATION.rule: The two categories alternate at every adjacent position, with the allowed starting category determined by the category sizes or stem.

NO_TWO_CATEGORY_MEMBERS_ADJACENT.rule: Every member of the smaller or specified category occupies a different gap formed by the remaining objects.

EXACT_GAP_BETWEEN_PAIR.rule: Exactly the stated number of other objects lies between two specified objects.

AT_LEAST_GAP_BETWEEN_PAIR.rule: At least the stated number of other objects lies between two specified objects.

SPECIFIED_OBJECTS_IN_POSITION_CLASS.rule: Exactly the stated number of specified objects occupies the eligible odd-numbered or even-numbered position class.

POSITION_GAP_INVERSE.rule: Search the stated finite gap domain and require one exact target match.
